checkpoint: fused exact trivariate construction and retained oblique-contact replay

changed: short signed sums of trivariate products now convolve directly into one bounded result tensor
short affine combinations used by retained coordinate, linear-form, derived-point, and equality replay now accumulate into one bounded result tensor
radical sign replay can borrow rational and radical components without cloning a retained dense tensor
the oblique circle/chord construction, radical magnitude comparison, and derived replay use the fused primitives
unchanged: the selected-root refinement and exact sign authority
the 16384-control resource ceiling and Unsupported result on exhaustion
STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512 terminal policy handling
the retained contact representation, public API, and benchmark fixture

exactness.construction: Each coefficient remains a hyperreal::Real and is accumulated with exact Real arithmetic. No floating preview, primitive element, or approximate coordinate is introduced.
exactness.cap: Every fused result checks the same rectangular tensor control count before allocation; multiplication still materializes required intermediate powers when the old path did so for capability safety.
exactness.policy: The fused helpers do not make decisions. All signs still terminate in the shared selected-root predicate path, including the APPROXIMATE_512 terminal only when exact proof remains unavailable.
exactness.mathematical_paths: Positive, negative, zero, tangent, transverse, clipped, reversed, endpoint, and disjoint outcomes retain the pre-optimization branch filters and carriers.

benchmark_method.wall: Nine process pairs per lane, one Runner sample per process, alternating baseline/current execution order; 16 timed iterations for evidence and the shared four-Boolean batch, 5 for Boolean plus re-offset. Every timed sample includes the Runner warm-up outside the reported interval.
benchmark_method.perf: perf stat -r 5 on one process with 64 timed iterations plus one warm-up for evidence/four, and 32 plus one warm-up for re-offset. Subtract the implementation-filter=disabled process, then divide by 65 or 33.
benchmark_method.heap: Heaptrack record-only with 32 timed iterations plus one warm-up. Subtract the disabled process and divide by 33. Temporary counts come from heaptrack_print; exact peaks come from Massif export.
benchmark_method.size: GNU size and stat on the correctness-equivalent all-feature comparative executables.

wall_performance.interpretation: Wall time is neutral within process-to-process noise; the order-balanced medians do not establish a throughput regression or improvement. Retired exact work, allocation count, and linked size provide the stable win.

deterministic_perf.interpretation: All three exact lanes retire about 1.1% fewer instructions. Cycle, branch-miss, and cache-miss counts varied more between repeated perf sessions and are retained as raw evidence rather than claimed improvements.

allocation_evidence.interpretation: The fused construction removes 1923 allocation calls per evidence operation. Heaptrack's temporary-allocation definition is unchanged, and both incremental peaks remain approximately one kilobyte.

verification.all_features_clippy: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings: passed for Hypercurve; only the pre-existing Hypertri dependency dead-code warning was emitted
